title: Genetic association and machine learning improve the prediction of type 1 diabetes risk.
summary: The primary article combines genetic association/fine-mapping with a machine-learning risk model and reports specific T1D risk signals, nonlinear interactions and patient subclusters; performance and subgroup claims are cohort-specific. The result-bearing preprint preceded the 2026 journal version.
